name: task-progress
description: Shows a progress band above the prompt: a task progress bar with per-task durations, or the turn's tool calls as steps when there is no task list, plus elapsed time. Collapsed by default; press to expand.

nameMax.title: Max name length
nameMax.description: Width limit, in terminal columns (CJK characters take 2), for names in the task/step list and the collapsed summary; longer names are cut and end with "…". Narrower terminals tighten it further. The running label on the progress line is never truncated.

foldThreshold.title: Fold threshold
foldThreshold.description: When there are more tasks than this, fold the earlier completed ones.

keepDone.title: Completed tasks to keep
keepDone.description: Number of most recently completed tasks to keep when folding (0 folds them all).
